belonged.line: And I felt like I belonged
stanza: The air was crisp
Like sunny late Winter days
A Springtime yawning high in the haze
And I felt like I belonged
Come with me

belonged.line: And I had a feeling that I belonged
stanza: So I remember when we were drivin', drivin' in your car
Speed so fast, I felt like I was drunk
City lights lay out before us
And your arm felt nice wrapped 'round my shoulder
And I had a feeling that I belonged
I had a feelin' I could be someone
Be someone, be someone
